rca of the issue: Original bug: due only decreased by amount_paid, ignoring approved_discount. Root cause was that balance/remaining computations aggregated Payment.discount into total_paid path only via subtotal but the balance formula subtracted total_paid (= subtotal - discount) and did not separately subtract the payment-level discount. Fix (already in code): student_dues now computes total_payment_discount = sum(payment.discount) and balance = total_expected - total_discount - total_payment_discount - total_paid. student_fee_schedule mirrors this via remaining_balance = net_annual - total_paid - total_payment_discount and _build_month_schedule accepts extra_paid_credit. report_fee_status aggregates pay_disc_by_stu and computes expected_after_disc = expected - disc - pay_disc; row discount now includes pay_disc. Verified: delta_balance == approved_discount + total_paid across all three endpoints.
